shots.headline: New website for MC Attorneys
shots.line: Hi! Here's a website we just launched for Makuwatsine Chirenje Attorneys in Harare.
Law firms win clients on trust, so we designed a site that feels established from the very first second.
On a phone, every practice area, the whole team, and a Book a Consultation button are just a scroll away.

shots.line: We built clear practice area pages, team profiles, and one-tap consultation booking.
And updating the site is easy: the team can post a new article in minutes, with no developer needed.
